title: Timeouts and 5xx on inventory-service
description: Elevated latency on inventory-service (p95 1.8s) with rising errors reported by consumers.
root_cause_detail: External dependency warehouse-api degraded and responded slowly; inventory-service calls exceeded the 3000ms client timeout. The degradation was intermittent (flapping).
expected_symptoms: inventory-service downstream_latency_ms rises from ~80ms to ~2.2s (client timeout 3000ms)
timeout and retry logs on calls from inventory-service to warehouse-api
inventory-service p95 latency rises to ~1.8s, error rate up to ~6.8%
inventory-service CPU and memory stay near baseline
resolution: Failed over to the secondary warehouse-api region and tuned the inventory-service timeout and retry budget.
